findings.description: The Total box has a -46px top margin and position:relative, so it overlaps and hides the last table row. At 1280px the 'Project dinner $93.25' row (and its Edit/Delete) is covered; at 360px the last card's Edit/Delete actions are covered. The last expense cannot be seen or clicked (Playwright confirms the Total intercepts pointer events on the last Delete button) (same overlap for viewer).
repro: Look at the bottom of the table: the Total box covers the last row (Project dinner)

findings.description: Global CSS removes the focus indicator (':focus, :focus-visible { outline: none }') with no replacement, so keyboard users cannot see which link, button or input is focused on any page (expenses, login, add/edit forms).
repro: Observe no visible focus ring on Apply, Edit, Delete, Add expense, Sign out

notes: Checked totals (all and filtered correct), viewer permissions (403 on new/edit/delete), login errors, 404s, add/delete flow. Very long unbroken titles overflow horizontally at 360px (not reported, edge case).

cost.notes: estimate from 32504 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0065-$0.0780
